bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
root=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 71
test -d "$root" || exit 72
matches=0
unit=''
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
  [ -n "$candidate" ] || continue
  body="$(systemctl --user cat "$candidate" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fqi "$target"; then
    matches=$((matches+1))
    unit="$candidate"
  fi
done < <(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$matches" -eq 1 ] || exit 73
if ! systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit"; then
  systemctl --user start "$unit" || exit 74
  systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit" || exit 75
  printf 'COLLECTOR_RESTORED\n'
  exit 0
fi
pid="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)"
[ "$pid" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 76
test -r "/proc/$pid/io" || exit 77
a="$(awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{printf "%.0f",s}' "/proc/$pid/io")"
sleep 12
b="$(awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{printf "%.0f",s}' "/proc/$pid/io")"
test "$b" -ge "$a" || exit 78
if [ "$b" -gt "$a" ]; then printf 'ACTIVE_AND_IO_ADVANCING\n'; exit 0; fi
printf 'ACTIVE_WITHOUT_IO_CHANGE\n'
exit 79
